description: This file contains the implementation of the ModuleConfigurationService for handling module configurations, including fetching modules by code and retrieving integration module details with JSON parsing and caching.

classes.name: ModuleConfigurationServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation class for module configuration management, extending generic entity service and implementing ModuleConfigurationService. Provides methods to retrieve modules by code and fetch detailed module configurations with caching and JSON parsing.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches an IntegrationModule entity based on the provided module code.

methods.name: getIntegrationModules
methods.description: Retrieves a list of IntegrationModule objects for a given module, with caching, and processes embedded JSON strings into structured objects.
